nodes.label: Finding 28a-06 - Fifty-nine against 52
nodes.rationale: Sharpened from a bound to a match. 52 of 162 by author and year against the printed Fifty-nine; bracketed 52/55/55/57/58 at tolerances to +/-5, none reaching 59, and 70 with the year dropped. 1736 is NOT withdrawn - its fifty-nine is a 172-row datum printed beside a 162-row count.

nodes.label: Finding 28a-08 - '16 of 162' is not a bound
nodes.rationale: r2-ch28a's extractor required a following initial, bracket, ampersand, comma or dash, so a bare surname row yielded nothing - no surname at all from 123 of 162 rows, and all 16 it caught were multi-author rows. Properly extracted the overlap is 70. It matters in the direction of the book: 16 < 59 reads as refutation, 70 > 59 does not.

nodes.label: Finding 28a-09 - the Janet row falsifies 'never listed'
nodes.rationale: The compendium's | 1929 | Janet | at mc L3431 and the References' Janet, C. (1928) at main L11777 are one work under two years, so the 1929 row belongs to 'the rest' and the volume did list it. Seventeen further authors on both lists at other years are carried as NEAR, an upper bound, never assigned.

nodes.label: CONVENTION AY
nodes.rationale: Where a claim asserts two lists SHARE members, the reading matches on the identity the claim names, and the matcher is asserted against named instances of the list's own citation forms before any count prints. Corollary that decided the unit: a bound BELOW the printed figure and a bound ABOVE it are not the same evidence, and an extractor reading nothing from three quarters of its rows produces the first by accident.

nodes.label: Register 1736
nodes.rationale: States its own basis in terms - matching the compendium's '172 works, 1669-2026' against the References by author and year found fifty-nine shared - and the ten removals that took 172 to 162 came afterwards. Not withdrawn.

nodes.label: Census mc 387-672 (286 C13-HANDLE-LEAK rows)
nodes.rationale: Engaged and NOT closed: this reading took the year and work columns only, the class is ruled elsewhere (26b-10, ruling 46, docket 28), and a row is not closed on a reading that did not take it.
